title: Opposition to the Work

questions.question: How did Sanballat react when he heard they were building the wall?
options: He was angry and greatly enraged
questions.correctAnswer: He was angry and greatly enraged
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:1 (ESV): "...he was angry and greatly enraged, and he jeered at the Jews."

questions.question: What did Tobiah say about their wall?
options: If a fox goes up on it he will break down their stone wall
questions.correctAnswer: If a fox goes up on it he will break down their stone wall
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:3 (ESV): "...if a fox goes up on it he will break down their stone wall!"

questions.question: Why did the people build the wall to half its height?
options: For the people had a mind to work
questions.correctAnswer: For the people had a mind to work
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:6 (ESV): "...for the people had a mind to work."

questions.question: What did the enemies plot to do when the breaches began to be closed?
options: Come and fight against Jerusalem and to cause confusion
Send a letter to the king
questions.correctAnswer: Come and fight against Jerusalem and to cause confusion
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:8 (ESV): "And they all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and to cause confusion in it."

questions.question: How did the Jews respond to the plot?
options: We prayed to our God and set a guard
questions.correctAnswer: We prayed to our God and set a guard
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:9 (ESV): "And we prayed to our God and set a guard as a protection against them day and night."

questions.question: What did the people of Judah say about the laborers?
options: The strength of those who bear the burdens is failing
questions.correctAnswer: The strength of those who bear the burdens is failing
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:10 (ESV): "...The strength of those who bear the burdens is failing. There is too much rubble..."

questions.question: How many times did the Jews living near the enemies warn Nehemiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:12 (ESV): "...they said to us ten times, 'From all places where they live they will come up against us.'"

questions.question: Where did Nehemiah station the people with weapons?
options: In the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in open places
questions.correctAnswer: In the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in open places
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:13 (ESV): "So in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in open places, I stationed the people..."

questions.question: What encouragement did Nehemiah give the leaders?
options: Do not be afraid... Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome
questions.correctAnswer: Do not be afraid... Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:14 (ESV): "...Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome..."

questions.question: How was the work divided from that day on?
options: Half of my servants worked on construction, and half held the spears
questions.correctAnswer: Half of my servants worked on construction, and half held the spears
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:16 (ESV): "From that day on, half of my servants worked on construction, and half held the spears..."

questions.question: How did the builders carry their loads?
options: With one hand doing the work and the other holding a weapon
questions.correctAnswer: With one hand doing the work and the other holding a weapon
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:17 (ESV): "...each burdened with his load worked with one hand and held his weapon with the other."

questions.question: Who stayed with Nehemiah to blow the trumpet?
options: The man who blew the trumpet
questions.correctAnswer: The man who blew the trumpet
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:18 (ESV): "...And the one who sounded the trumpet was beside me."

questions.question: What was the signal for the people to gather?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:20 (ESV): "In the place where you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally to us there..."

questions.question: What promise did Nehemiah make about the battle?
options: Our God will fight for us
questions.correctAnswer: Our God will fight for us
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:20 (ESV): "...Our God will fight for us."

questions.question: Did Nehemiah and his men take off their clothes?
options: None... took off his clothes; each kept his weapon at his right hand
questions.correctAnswer: None... took off his clothes; each kept his weapon at his right hand
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:23 (ESV): "...None of us took off our clothes; each kept his weapon at his right hand."

key_verse_text: And I looked and arose and said to the nobles and to the officials and to the rest of the people, “Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your homes.”
